corrected_complete_plan.principle: #K2-404: wipe FIRST, place on the cleared field, THEN stitch - copy the C17 v1 islands->stitch section onto the wipe_resolve chain (additive; zero search; zero parameter tuning).
corrected_complete_plan.stage: 2c_endpoint_stitch (new, additive, AFTER the second maze pass and BEFORE the refill)
corrected_complete_plan.per_line_method: for each remaining unconnected pair (a,b) of the same net, take the endpoint points+layers from the DRC; route a DETERMINISTIC stitch with the SAME in-domain maze (k2_p4_mroute_v1.maze_route, the same --bound-rect wall) from a to b; if the maze refuses (the very failure we are fixing), fall back to ONE deterministic L/45-degree 2-segment stitch on a's layer, then let the final DRC gate accept or reject it (a rejected stitch is NAMED, never silently dropped).
corrected_complete_plan.layers_slots_holes_corridors_rule: every emitted stitch is a normal track polyline on the endpoint's layer with the in-register width; no new vias unless the two endpoints are on different layers, in which case exactly one via at the corner (layer pair = the maze's TRANS set).
